content: Phoenix's own releases guide (hexdocs.pm/phoenix/releases.html) generates bin/migrate and bin/server overlay scripts via 'mix phx.gen.release --docker', and explicitly says: 'you may want to change the server script to migrate your database before starting your app' - but does NOT ship a concrete ENTRYPOINT script by default; the Dockerfile it generates just ends with CMD ["/app/bin/server"]. The community-standard pattern (used across Kamal+Phoenix deploy guides) is to add a custom docker-entrypoint shell script that checks if the container's command is 'bin/server', and if so runs 'bin/migrate' to completion first, then 'exec bin/server' - set as the Dockerfile's ENTRYPOINT. This is what backs this project's D-05 decision.
